Subject: Post-demo compliance recap - DPA scope, SCC module choice & controller alignment (Finthrive)

Hi Emma — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our end and a proposed set of next steps so your legal/compliance team can triage: 

Key asks from Finthrive that we noted:
- Confirm SOC 2 status and expected completion date (if in progress)
- Desired DPA coverage (data types / retention / subprocessor list expectations)
- Which SCC module your team prefers for EU transfers (Module A vs Module B tradeoffs)
- Controller/Processor alignment for the integration (your side controller + Redwood processor typical, but flag if you expect otherwise)

Action items from Redwood (proposed):
1) I attach a short vendor security questionnaire for you to fill (Finthrive_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx) — this will speed SOC 2 evidence collection.
2) I'll send a draft DPA that defaults to Redwood as processor; we can swap language if your legal prefers a different mapping. (attached: Redwood-DPA-draft.docx)
3) Attached is a one-page primer on SCC module options (SCC-Module-Options.pdf) — please indicate which module you prefer or share any mandatory language.
4) If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min follow-up with Laura (privacy) and Aditya (security) to go through the questionnaire and DPA redlines.

Proposed follow-up times: Mon 8/23 9:00–9:30 AM PT or Tue 8/24 10:00–10:30 AM PT. Let me know which works and any additional stakeholders to loop in.

Thanks — Rishi

Subject: Re: Post-demo compliance recap - DPA scope, SCC module choice & controller alignment (Finthrive)

Thanks Rishi — helpful recap. Quick answers from our side: 

- SOC 2: In progress. Type II audit started July; expected completion the week of Oct 11 (report available ~Oct 18).
- DPA scope: Primary data will be product telemetry and hashed PII used for personalization. Retention expectations: 13 months for telemetry, 24 months for hashed identifiers.
- SCC module: Our international counsel prefers Module 2 for processor-to-processor scenarios but they asked whether Redwood can accept Module 1 (controller->processor) as well; they will confirm if Module 2 is a hard requirement.
- Controller/Processor: Finthrive expects to remain controller for user data. We expect Redwood to be the processor for the integration. If Redwood's default DPA assumes any different mapping, please point out.

I started the questionnaire and will finish it by EOD Monday. We may also want Laura on a follow-up call to talk SCC modules and the DPA language.

Best,
Emma

--
Emma Jones

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo compliance recap - DPA scope, SCC module choice & controller alignment (Finthrive)

Rishi / Aditya — notes and recommended approach from privacy: 

1) Controller/Processor: Default Redwood position = processor for customer data in SaaS usage. That aligns with Finthrive's expectation. We'll include explicit language in the DPA that: (a) Finthrive is controller; (b) Redwood acts as processor; (c) subprocessor list will be provided and updated by schedule.

2) SCC modules: Provide both options in the DPA — Module 1 (controller->processor) as the default for clarity, plus an appendix describing Module 2 mapping and mechanics in case counsel insists on a processor-to-processor mechanism. This keeps both paths open and minimizes back-and-forth.

3) SOC 2 evidence: Since their report isn't ready until Oct, we should accept an interim security pack (architecture diagram + recent internal control matrices + expected audit scope) to unblock procurement. Ask them for the pack in the questionnaire.

4) Small tweak to questionnaire: add a targeted question about retention triggers and deletion verification for hashed identifiers.

If we want, Aditya and I can join the 30-min review. Proposed slots: Tue 8/24 10:00 AM PT (preferred) or Wed 8/25 11:30 AM PT.

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Senior Privacy Counsel, Redwood Inference

Emma — appreciate the quick turnaround. Two quick follow-ups and a proposed next step: 

1) Thanks for SOC 2 timing. If you can upload the interim security pack (architecture diagram + control matrices) to the questionnaire, that should keep procurement moving until the Type II report is available.

2) SCC choice: Per Laura's suggestion, we'll include both modules in the DPA draft I attached (SCC-Module-Options.pdf shows the differences). If counsel confirms Module 2 is mandatory, we will switch to that flow; otherwise Module 1 as default is fine.

3) Draft DPA & small retention clause change: we attached a DPA draft with the retention items set to the values you listed (13m telemetry / 24m hashed ids). Please review and flag redlines. (attachments: Redwood-DPA-draft.docx)

4) Can we lock the follow-up call for Tue 8/24 10:00 AM PT? We have Laura + Aditya on that slot. If you confirm, I'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Rishi
